name: Uemura Aoi
source:
Sister of his best friend and a childhood playmate, Aoi is the young woman Kouichi is prearranged to marry. Despite their long friendship, she had somewhat grown distant upon discovering her future as his wife, and seeks to break off the deal. Nonetheless, there seems to be something more than Aoi wants to reveal.

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20070211064424/http://www.elizar.com/?p=3]Nargrakhan's review[/url]]
